steps.title: Check Your Eligibility
steps.body: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page Connect your wallet Click “Verify Now” to view your status If your results appear incorrect, contact the AIW3 support team to request a manual review.

steps.title: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page
steps.body: Go to the AIW3 airdrop page and open the Airdrop tab. This is where your points, tasks, and ranking live.

steps.title: Connect your wallet and complete the tutorial
steps.body: Connect your wallet and then finish the onboarding tutorial on the Airdrop tab. Wallet binding is required for the snapshot, so do this before July 28.

steps.title: Check in daily
steps.body: Hit the check-in button every day. Rewards follow a 7-day cycle that climbs from 3 points on day 1 to 10 points on day 7, and missing a day does not reset your progress.

steps.title: Complete the community tasks
steps.body: Follow AIW3 on X, repost the featured campaign post, and join the AIW3 Telegram from the airdrop page. These one-time tasks pay 10 to 20 points each and take about two minutes.

steps.title: Make daily predictions
steps.body: Complete at least one prediction market entry per day for 20 points. Three predictions in a day pays 50 points, and inviting a friend who completes a prediction adds another 30. The prediction tasks reset daily, so they compound fast for consistent users.

steps.title: Trade on the platform
steps.body: You earn points for every 1,000 USDT in trading volume, plus milestone bonuses for consistent activity. You can grab USDT or SOL on Bybit , and if your funds sit on another chain, the widget below moves them over to Solana or BNB Chain in one transaction. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Publish AI strategies
steps.body: Create trading strategies and publish them to the Strategy Square. Strategy rewards are repeatable, so this suits users who want points without constant manual activity.

steps.title: Refer friends
steps.body: Share your referral link from the airdrop page. Referrals earn bonus points when invited users stay active, and they stack with the daily prediction invite task.

steps.title: Verify eligibility and claim
steps.body: Check the eligibility page from July 29, then claim your tokens when TGE goes live on August 3.

items.description: The AIW3 Genesis Airdrop eligibility checker opened July 29, letting you verify whether your address qualifies based on the July 28 snapshot. The checker displays snapshot eligibility, wallet verification status, and initial airdrop qualification.

items.name: Onchain Cc
items.tagline: The Onchain.cc team has not confirmed a native token or token airdrop. The platform’s Colosseum points system, sessions,

steps.title: Visit Onchain.cc
steps.body: Head to the Onchain.cc terminal and click “Start trading” on the landing page.

steps.title: Authenticate with Privy
steps.body: Sign in using one of the supported methods: Email — Privy creates an embedded non-custodial wallet for you. Google account — same flow as email, signed in with Gmail. External EVM wallet — connect MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet. Privy handles key management without holding your funds, so you keep custody throughout.

steps.title: Fund Your Wallets
steps.body: Open the wallet menu in the top right to see your Solana and EVM addresses. Ensure you have USDC, SOL, or ETH in your wallet. If you don’t have any, you can get them from Binance or swap and bridge funds directly using the widget below.

steps.title: Place Your First Trade
steps.body: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Three discovery paths feed into the same trading panel: Degen Feed (Trenches): Solana-only memecoin discovery with trending tokens and new launches. Contract address search: paste any token’s CA into the search bar to load its chart directly. Discover tab: filter by volume, market cap, or other criteria to find trending markets. Set your size, check the slippage estimate, and submit. Points accrue automatically based on your volume and any session multipliers active at the time.

steps.title: Climb the Colosseum Leaderboard
steps.body: Open the Colosseum tab to see the active season, current session timer, and any live Bonus Windows. Trading during a Bonus Window (typically 2x or 3x points for a few hours) is the fastest way to push your session rank.

steps.title: Earn Points from X Posts
steps.body: Onchain.cc runs a social scoring system that pays Colosseum points for posting about the platform on X. Tag the official @Onchaincc account so the AI scorer picks up your post. Quality, reach, and engagement determine the score on a 0–100 scale. Posts that share a real trade, include a screenshot of the terminal, or generate organic engagement score well. Spam and copy-paste content score near zero.

steps.title: Trade Perps on Hyperliquid Markets
steps.body: Switch to the perps tab to trade Hyperliquid’s 300+ markets from the same interface. Perp volume feeds into your Colosseum points the same way spot volume does, often with higher leverage and tighter spreads. Check funding rates before opening leveraged positions.

steps.title: Stack Sessions and Refer Friends
steps.body: Sessions reset weekly, each with its own leaderboard and USDC prize pool. Daily and weekly quests sit alongside the leaderboard, adding points and prize pool entries on top of your trading activity. You can also refer your friends to earn more points.

items.description: The Onchain.cc team has not confirmed a native token or token airdrop. The platform’s Colosseum points system, sessions, and seasonal leaderboards point toward a possible retroactive reward for early traders, similar to how other trading terminals have rewarded volume contributors before launching a token.

items.name: Memebook
items.tagline: The Memebook airdrop is confirmed in principle: the project states that XP earned in the app today converts into $MBK ut

steps.title: Fund a Solana Wallet
steps.body: Install Phantom or Solflare and keep a small amount of SOL in it for network fees, tips, and any paid Pass tier. You can buy SOL on Bybit and withdraw straight to your Solana address.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Mint Page
steps.body: Open the Memebook mint page , connect the wallet you just funded, and sign the verification message. Use this same wallet throughout, since XP is tied to the address rather than a username.

steps.title: Verify Your X and Telegram Accounts
steps.body: Link both accounts on the mint page. Verification is required before minting and includes following the Memebook X account and joining the Telegram channel.

steps.title: Mint Your Memebook Pass
steps.body: Bronze is free and gets you into the app. Paid tiers raise your XP multiplier and daily limits, which compounds across every post. The Pass is soulbound, so it stays attached to the minting wallet and cannot be resold.

steps.title: Install the Android App
steps.body: Download Memebook from Google Play and sign in with the wallet holding your Pass. There is no iOS build, so an Android device is required for the in-app half of the campaign.

steps.title: Post and Engage Daily
steps.body: Publish photos or reels, like and comment on other creators, and complete the daily check-in. Spreading activity across days earns more than dumping the same volume into one session.

steps.title: Tip Creators and Share Your Invite Code
steps.body: Send SOL tips to posts you like, which is an on-chain action and counts toward your activity. Then share your invite link from the app to earn XP when someone you referred mints a Pass.

items.description: The Memebook airdrop is confirmed in principle: the project states that XP earned in the app today converts into $MBK utility at TGE. The allocation size and the XP-to-token rate have not been announced, so the sensible goal right now is banking XP rather than modelling a payout.

steps.body: Go to the Collector Crypt platform and sign in with your email or wallet.

steps.body: Open packs through the Gacha Machine using USDC or $CARDS. This is the core activity that builds your points balance. Each pack reveals a tokenized card you can keep, trade, sell back instantly, or redeem for the physical version.

steps.title: Join Weekly Gacha Games Challenges
steps.body: Take part in the weekly Gacha Games for badges and a share of points prize pools. These themed challenges reward consistent participation and add to your quarterly standing.

steps.body: Buy $CARDS on Raydium (contract: CARDSccUMFKoPRZxt5vt3ksUbxEFEcnZ3H2pd3dKxYjp) and hold it to qualify for the separate monthly holder airdrops. Holding also lets you pay for packs in $CARDS.

steps.body: Generate your referral link on the platform and use it when onboarding others. Current-quarter referral points carry a bonus, so active referrals can meaningfully raise your allocation.

steps.title: Claim Your Rewards
steps.body: When a quarterly distribution goes live, claim through the official page and connect the wallet you used for activity. The Q2 2026 rewards were processed on June 14, with 15,000,000 $CARDS (0.75% of total supply) allocated across the ecosystem. Review and claim your allocation at claim.collectorcrypt.com .

items.description: The Collector Crypt airdrop is confirmed and recurring. The team runs a quarterly rewards program that distributes $CARDS to active users, and $CARDS holders receive separate monthly airdrops on top of that. steps.title: Claim Test ETH from the Faucet
steps.body: Open the Robinhood Chain Testnet Faucet , enter your wallet address, and request test ETH. You need it for gas and for trading on the testnet.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to Vibe Vibe
steps.body: Go to the Vibe Vibe testnet and connect your EVM wallet. If your wallet asks you to add or switch to Robinhood Chain Testnet, approve it.

steps.title: Create a Testnet Token
steps.body: Click the launch option and fill in the details: Token name and ticker Token image (required) A short description of the project Put some effort into it, because the team says quality launches count.

steps.title: Buy and Sell Testnet Tokens
steps.body: Trade tokens launched by other users. Buy early on the bonding curve and sell into strength, since high PnL is one of the listed eligibility criteria.

steps.title: Join the Telegram Raiding Channel
steps.body: Join the Vibe Vibe Telegram and take part in raids on X. You need a verified X account, and the top 250 raiders qualify for a free Vibe Vibers NFT.

steps.title: Apply for a Vibe Vibers Whitelist
steps.body: Follow the Vibe Vibers page for mint updates. Creators who make memes or other content can apply for collab spots when the form opens, with free mint whitelists awarded based on quality.

items.description: Vibe Vibe says 5% of its token supply is set aside for testnet participants. Traders with strong PnL, token creators, and active users are the groups named as eligible. The allocation is discretionary: the team can exclude sybil and wash-trading wallets, and testnet points or leaderboard positions do not guarantee a reward.

steps.title: Sign Up at Yakkamon
steps.body: Create your account with an email address on the Yakkamon pre-registration page . No wallet is needed at this stage. Enter the referral code YAKKA-52UCFU during sign-up.

steps.title: Nurture Your Egg Daily
steps.body: Tap your egg three times each day for +6 points. Daily streaks add bonuses, and a missed day resets the streak.

steps.title: Connect Discord and X
steps.body: Link your Discord and X accounts for +10 points each. Helpful posts in the Discord earn extra points through community reactions, and the weekly share quest pays +20 points per week once X is connected.

steps.title: Link and Verify a Wallet
steps.body: Connect a wallet and sign a message to prove ownership for +10 points. A verified wallet is also required for the free mint whitelist, so complete this well before October 1, 2026.

steps.title: Refer Friends
steps.body: Each verified friend who joins earns you +30 points. Your first five referrals count instantly; after that, invitees must verify Discord and X and reach 100 points before the bonus lands. Multi-accounting gets filtered out on review.

steps.title: Mint the Free Monster NFT on October 1
steps.body: Join the free mint of 10,000 Monster NFTs on Ronin using your verified wallet. It costs nothing beyond a small gas fee, is limited to one mint per trainer, and minting adds points to your leaderboard total.

steps.title: Mint Your Yakkamon NFT
steps.body: Check which waves your Ronin wallet qualifies for on the whitelist checker Deposit 5 $FLOWER if you’re minting in Wave 2 or Wave 4 (see the $FLOWER deposit guide ) Connect your Ronin wallet to the Ronin Launchpad when your wave opens and mint, keeping some RON for gas

items.description: The Yakkamon airdrop is confirmed and NFT focused. The top 5,000 trainers on the Season 0 points leaderboard receive Monster NFTs when early access launches: ranks 1 to 1,000 get Legendary Monster NFTs and ranks 1,001 to 5,000 get Rare Monster NFTs. Distribution is automatic and based purely on points, never on sign-up order. The same leaderboard decides early access, with the top 100,000 trainers entering in waves.

steps.body: You need USDC or ETH on Base to trade. You can buy either asset on Bybit and withdraw directly to Base. Holding funds on another chain? Move them over with the bridge widget below. steps.body: Pick the token you want to sell and the one you want to buy, enter an amount, and review the quote. Click “Trade,” approve the token if prompted, and sign. No gas is needed.

steps.title: Trade Regularly to Build Points
steps.body: Points are based on trading volume and activity. Spread trades across different days and token pairs instead of placing one large swap, and check the app for any active multipliers before you trade.

steps.title: Trade Tokenized Stocks for Boosted Points
steps.body: If tokenized stocks are available in your jurisdiction, swap into them on BaiBai. These trades have earned a temporary 2x points boost, so confirm the multiplier is still running first.

steps.body: Visit the BaiBai Rekt page , generate your receipt, and share it to collect bonus points.

steps.body: Open the Points page and copy your referral link. You earn 10% of the points your referrals generate, and they receive a 10% points boost.

items.description: BaiBai has not announced a token or airdrop, so this is a speculative opportunity. The team launched a points program alongside the public release, rewarding traders based on volume and activity. Early users get the biggest boost, and there is no official word yet on how points might convert to tokens.

steps.body: The project lists its official Base contract as 0xB095274743941e953c746F9C228DA9c18Bb6ec29 . Verify it on the official LAPTOP website rather than a screener or a search result. Our crypto safety guide explains how fake claim pages work.

steps.body: Connect an eligble Email adress, connect wallet if you have an allocation. With an embedded wallet, export your keys or move the tokens out afterwards, since access depends on that service staying up.

steps.body: A self-custody claim needs a little ETH on Base for gas. Buy ETH on Bybit and withdraw straight to Base, or move some across from another network using the widget below. steps.body: Sign the claim transaction and confirm the tokens arrive. Read what you sign. A legitimate claim never asks for a seed phrase and never asks you to send funds first.

steps.title: Check Your Exchange for the TRUMP Loss Share
steps.body: If you qualify through TRUMP losses, watch announcements from the exchange or app where you traded. Each venue sets its own rules, so allocations vary and some may sit out.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Loyalty Dashboard
steps.body: Open the Beldex Loyalty Program and connect an EVM wallet. Your points and rank attach to that address, so use a wallet you intend to keep.

steps.title: Link Your X Account
steps.body: Connect X from the dashboard before starting tasks. Rewards do not pay out without an X connection, and the same applies to anyone you refer.

steps.title: Clear the Community Tasks
steps.body: One-time actions that you need to complete from the airdrop page that cover most of your opening balance: Follow Beldex on X (100 points) Follow Beldex on LinkedIn (100 points) Join the Discord server (100 points) Subscribe to the YouTube channel (100 points) Join the Telegram community group (50 points) Join the Telegram announcement channel (50 points) Join the X Community (50 points)

steps.title: Complete the Limited-Time and Collab Tasks
steps.body: The dashboard rotates timed partner tasks, usually a follow or a like. Some run for days, others expire in under eight hours, so clear them on sight.

steps.title: Post About Beldex on X Daily
steps.body: Write a post about Beldex, tag @BeldexCoin, then paste the link into the Submit Post field. This pays 20 points and resets every 24 hours. Spam risks rejection, so write about a product or update you have used.

steps.title: Check In Once Per Week
steps.body: The weekly check-in pays 20 points and resets every seven days. One click, and skipping it is the easiest way to leak points over a long campaign.

steps.title: Generate Your Referral Link and Invite Friends
steps.body: Use the Get My Referral Link button. You earn 20% of your direct referrals’ earnings plus 5% from anyone they refer, and each friend gets 100 XP for signing up through you. Credit takes 24 to 48 hours, and referred accounts must connect X first.

items.description: Beldex runs a Loyalty Program that awards Beldex Points for social and community tasks and ranks participants on a public leaderboard. The program page states that point holders become eligible for an airdrop and other incentives, but the points-to-BDX conversion rate, the reward pool size, and the snapshot date have not been announced.

steps.body: Go to the Gyndore reservation portal . The old DropWave campaign page now redirects here, so any saved bookmark should land in the same place.

steps.title: Connect the Wallet You Used in Season One
steps.body: Reservations attach to existing Season One profiles. Connect the same wallet that collected Chips during the campaign, since a fresh wallet has no allocation tied to it.

steps.title: Authenticate Your DropWave Profile
steps.body: The portal verifies the X account you linked during the campaign before it shows a balance. Approve the sign-in request so your GynPoints can be matched to the connected wallet.

steps.title: Confirm Your Base Receiving Address
steps.body: Set the Base address that should receive bGYND. Use an address you hold the keys to, because exchange deposit addresses often reject tokens they have not listed.

steps.body: Confirm the reservation and check that the portal shows it as reserved. Gyndore has not announced a fallback for allocations left unreserved after 09.09.26, so treat the date as final.

steps.body: Bookies NFTs live on Sui at TBook’s NFT page. Holding one raises your Wealth Score and puts you in the airdrop category reserved for early supporters, the most direct eligibility upgrade here.

steps.title: Create your MINT account
steps.body: Register on the MINT website . An account is required before any play counts toward Season 1 XP.

steps.title: Fund your MINT wallet
steps.body: Deposit USDT, USDC or ETH into your MINT wallet on one of the supported networks. Make sure the network selected on MINT matches the one used by your sending wallet or exchange, since deposits sent over the wrong network can be lost. Alternatively, you can pick up any of these assets directly through the Mint cashier tab cash on-ramp.

steps.body: Every eligible play earns Season 1 XP. You need at least $50 wagered cumulatively to qualify for the airdrop, so smaller regular sessions count just as much as one large bet.

steps.title: Climb the XP leaderboard
steps.body: Your XP sets your position on the live leaderboard. A higher rank at the snapshot means a larger potential share of the $125,000 pool. Qualifying referrals, available boosts and selected quests add XP on top of your own play.

steps.title: Keep earning XP until the snapshot
steps.body: The Season 1 snapshot happens shortly before the TGE in Q4 2026, with the exact date announced through MINT’s official channels. Your verified XP at that moment locks in your allocation.

steps.title: Claim and stake your $MNTD
steps.body: At TGE, claim your allocation through the rewards section on mint.io. You can then stake your $MNTD to activate MINT Status, earn compounded staking rewards and start moving up the levels.

items.description: The Season 1 airdrop is confirmed and distributes $125,000 worth of $MNTD to eligible players based on verified platform activity. Casino and sportsbook play earns XP, and your final leaderboard position at the snapshot decides your share.

steps.title: Open the Genesis Vault and Connect Your Wallet
steps.body: Go to the HertzFlow Genesis Vault page and connect an EVM wallet. Anything supported by Privy works, including OKX Wallet, MetaMask, and Rabby. No invite code, no whitelist.

steps.title: Fund Your Wallet
steps.body: You need USD1 or U plus a little BNB for gas. Stablecoins can be bought on Bybit and withdrawn straight to BNB Chain. If your funds sit elsewhere, the widget below will bridge or swap them across. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Review and Accept the User Agreement
steps.body: Three disclosures gate the deposit form: smart contract risk, PnL exposure after mainnet, and the custody path. Deposits are wrapped into the underlying USD1 or U and held in Ceffu custody, so read it rather than clicking past.

steps.title: Deposit USD1 or U Into the Genesis Vault
steps.body: Enter at least $10 after fees, then approve and confirm. Holding a different token is fine, since the deposit flow swaps into USD1 or U first. Once the phase cap fills, the vault stops taking new money while existing deposits keep running.

steps.title: Bind Your X and Discord Accounts
steps.body: Optional, and it changes nothing about deposits or Merits. It does register you for future campaign eligibility, so there is little reason to skip.

steps.title: Hold the Deposit for 90 Continuous Days
steps.body: The boost is all or nothing. A deposit held 89 days earns the base rate; at 90 days it earns 10x on everything accrued over that window. After day 90 the boost stops growing, but base Merits keep accruing.

steps.title: Trade Once Season 2 Opens
steps.body: Perpetual trading opens in Season 2 once the Season 1 window closes, and depositors are already on the early access list. Trading uses a separate on-chain referral system that has not launched yet.

items.description: HertzFlow has confirmed both a token generation event and an airdrop. Official documentation describes Merits, the protocol’s reward points, as your weight in that airdrop: at TGE they convert into an allocation and reset to zero. Season 1 runs entirely through the Genesis Vault, a capped pre-deposit event where every Merit comes from supplying liquidity. Neither the allocation size nor a TGE date has been published.

items.name: Nowa
items.tagline: Nowa Farming is the opening phase of Nowa’s Community Development Program, which runs across Devnet (live now), Testnet,

steps.title: Open the Nowa Farming Page
steps.body: Go to the Nowa Farming page . Access is invite-only at this stage, so have a code ready before you start. The public code is NOWA.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet
steps.body: Click Connect Wallet and pick your wallet. Nowa supports MetaMask, Trust Wallet, WalletConnect, Phantom, Keplr, Solflare, and Typhon. Sign the connection request when prompted.

steps.title: Enter Your Invite Code
steps.body: Type NOWA into the invite field. Once accepted, you land on the Nowa Farming dashboard showing your balances, badge tier, and leaderboard rank.

steps.title: Complete the Three Mandatory Tasks
steps.body: Farming stays locked until all three are done: Follow Nowa on X and join the Telegram community Invite at least one friend using your personal invite code Click Request Funds to claim your free Devnet-value tokens The Request Funds drop includes NUSC, NOWA, ETH, BTC, BNB, TRX, USDC, USDT, XRP, and SOL, covering every activity in the program without a deposit from you.

steps.title: Trade on the Spot Orderbook
steps.body: Place buy and sell orders on the onchain orderbook. Spot volume feeds its own daily bucket and counts toward your leaderboard rank.

steps.title: Open BNPL Positions
steps.body: Buy an asset through the BNPL flow, post collateral, and settle the balance over time. This is the feature Nowa most wants tested, and it draws from a different daily bucket than spot.

steps.title: Stake into Vault and Earn
steps.body: Deposit NUSC into the Vault to finance other users’ BNPL positions, then stake into Earn for the second staking bucket. Both accrue NOWA continuously, so funds parked early keep working while you focus elsewhere.

steps.title: Build Your Referral Tree
steps.body: Share your invite code from the dashboard. Referral activity has its own daily bucket on top of the 10%, 5%, and 2.5% commissions.

items.description: Nowa Farming is the opening phase of Nowa’s Community Development Program, which runs across Devnet (live now), Testnet, and Mainnet. Participants earn NOWA tokens directly rather than points, and farmed NOWA converts to TGE allocation on a straight 1:1 basis.

items.name: Sweep Finance
items.tagline: The Sweep airdrop is a confirmed campaign with 27% of the total supply, roughly 270 million SWEEP, reserved for particip

steps.title: Sign Up on the Sweep Airdrop Page
steps.body: Visit the Sweep airdrop page and create an account using Google, X, email, or a connected wallet. Registration is free and takes under a minute.

steps.title: Verify Your Account
steps.body: Complete email, and KYC verification from your dashboard. Each verification level awards XP on its own, and a verified account keeps you eligible for the final distribution.

steps.title: Complete the Social Media Tasks
steps.body: Work through the social tasks in the campaign dashboard, such as following Sweep’s official channels. Finished tasks credit XP automatically, though some rewards take a short while to appear.

steps.title: Play Sweepbird Every Day
steps.body: Open Sweepbird and play at least one round daily. A single game keeps your streak alive, and streak milestones unlock Bird Tier badges that add XP to your account permanently. You can also earn additional XP by finishing in the Top 100 of the Sweepbird leaderboard, which refreshes daily.

steps.title: Invite Friends With Your Referral Link
steps.body: Grab the referral link from your dashboard and share it. Invites are repeatable, so each friend who signs up and participates keeps adding to your total.

steps.title: Make Eligible Purchases (Optional)
steps.body: Qualifying purchases can also award XP. Purchase-related tasks will become available once Phase 3 of the fairlaunch is active. Check the campaign dashboard for updates and eligibility details.

steps.title: Check Back for New Tasks and Events
steps.body: Sweep adds campaign tasks and special events while the airdrop runs. A quick daily look at the dashboard catches new XP sources early.

items.description: The Sweep airdrop is a confirmed campaign with 27% of the total supply, roughly 270 million SWEEP, reserved for participants. You collect XP by completing activities across the ecosystem, and your final allocation depends on the XP you hold when the campaign closes. The XP to SWEEP conversion rate and the TGE date have not been announced; both arrive after the campaign ends.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Wager Predict Testnet
steps.body: Visit the Wager Predict app and connect MetaMask or any WalletConnect wallet. Grab free tBNB for gas by clicking the faucet button.

steps.title: Claim 10,000 Testnet USDC
steps.body: Open the in-app faucet and claim. The claim sends 10,000 test USDC straight to your wallet.

steps.title: Approve USDC and Place Your First Trade
steps.body: Pick a live market, choose YES or NO, and enter an amount. Your first trade needs a one-time approval transaction before the buy confirms. Fees are 2% per trade, and selling works like buying, so you can exit any position up to one hour before expiry.

steps.title: Trade Across Markets and Test Leverage
steps.body: Spread bets across categories rather than parking everything in one market. Then try a leveraged position; 5x and 10x tiers unlock on higher-volume markets. Liquidations use a 30-minute average of the odds rather than spot, so one erratic trade will not instantly close you out.

steps.title: Create Your Own Markets
steps.body: Head to the market creation page and write a clearly worded question with an unambiguous resolution source. The protocol seeds the liquidity, so you take no market-making risk, and you collect 0.5% of every trade on your market for life.

steps.title: Stake in the LP Vault
steps.body: Deposit test USDC into the LP vault, which lends to leveraged traders and pays depositors a cut of their fees. Lock tiers of Flex, 90, 180, and 365 days carry point multipliers of 1x, 2x, 4x, and 8x, and the multiplier only applies while the lock is active. Withdrawals sit through a 7-day cooldown, even on Flex.

steps.title: Climb the Season 01 Leaderboard
steps.body: Track your P&L on the leaderboard, work through the onboarding achievements, and collect badges as you trade. Share your referral link from the dashboard to bring in other traders.

items.description: The airdrop is written directly into the official tokenomics: 10% of the 30 billion $WP supply, with no cliff, so recipients start liquid on day one.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to AlloX
steps.body: Go to the AlloX app and click “Connect Wallet”. MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, and most major wallets work. Connecting earns you your one-time 5,000 point welcome bonus.

steps.title: Fund Your Wallet on BNB Chain
steps.body: Portfolios execute on BNB Chain, so you need BNB for gas plus capital to invest. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Create Your First AI Portfolio
steps.body: Pick a narrative, choose a risk tier, and set your investment amount. The AI generates the basket, you review it, and you execute it on-chain. Each portfolio you create earns 250 points, and you can edit the basket through the chat before executing.

steps.title: Claim the Daily Bonus
steps.body: Log in every day and claim the 500 point daily bonus from the Earning Opportunities dashboard. Streaks are the cheapest points on the platform, so set a reminder.

steps.title: Complete the Social Tasks
steps.body: Finish the X based social tasks in your dashboard for another 500 points. These are one time tasks and take a few minutes.

steps.title: Join the Prove Your Portfolio Campaign
steps.body: Build one on-chain portfolio per day and share your portfolio card on X. This earns guaranteed Gem rewards from the $100,000 pool and stacks with the points you already earn per portfolio.

steps.title: Activate Your Referral Link
steps.body: Open the Referrals tab and click “Activate”. Referrals pay dollar rewards on top of points, and your network’s trading counts toward your Gems.

items.description: AlloX has not confirmed an airdrop, but its reward system points clearly at one. The $ALLOX token is unlaunched, with a token generation event planned for Q3 2026, and the platform runs two parallel reward currencies: points for everyday activity and Gems for volume based campaigns. AlloX has stated that 1 Gem will equal $5 in $ALLOX at launch, and over $1 million in rewards is spread across ongoing campaigns.
